pre-commit.description: Off by default in Renovate. The hook revs in .pre-commit-config.yaml sat untouched under Dependabot, which has no pre-commit support.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A fix for a known vulnerability does not wait for the nightly window. GitHub's 'Dependabot security updates' setting is switched off so one tool raises the pull request rather than two; the alerts themselves stay on — they are what this reads.

packageRules.description: The runtime dependencies are open '>=' floors, as a library's must be: new releases install without a pull request. What catches a breaking release is the weekly scheduled CI run against the newest versions (ci.yml), not Renovate — pyotp 2.12 broke 2FA secrets that way in November 2026.
GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks in one PR each. Non-major updates merge themselves once CI is green: the workflows are what validates the change, and neither reaches users.
